name: leadac-ai-video
description: Remotion launch film for Leadac AI. Composes Steel-captured plates into the master + delivery cuts.

scripts.render:ad: cross-env RENDER_PROFILE=master remotion render src/Root.tsx AdCut out/ad.mp4
scripts.render:ad:vertical: cross-env RENDER_PROFILE=master remotion render src/Root.tsx AdCutVertical out/ad-vertical.mp4
scripts.render:ad:teaser: cross-env RENDER_PROFILE=master remotion render src/Root.tsx AdTeaser15 out/ad-teaser.mp4
scripts.render:ad:webm: cross-env RENDER_PROFILE=master remotion render src/Root.tsx AdCut out/ad.webm --codec=vp9
scripts.render:ad:with-bed: cross-env RENDER_PROFILE=master remotion render src/Root.tsx AdCut out/ad-bed.mp4 --props="{\"audioBed\":true}"
scripts.render:ad:full: cross-env RENDER_PROFILE=master remotion render src/Root.tsx AdCut out/ad-full.mp4 --props="{\"audioBed\":true,\"audioVo\":true}"
scripts.render:ad:all: npm run render:ad && npm run render:ad:vertical && npm run render:ad:teaser
scripts.render:all: npm run render:master && npm run render:hero && npm run render:vertical && npm run render:square && npm run render:showcase && npm run render:launch && npm run render:ad:all
scripts.encode:web: ffmpeg -y -i out/hero-loop.mp4 -vcodec libx265 -crf 28 -tag:v hvc1 ../public/hero-loop.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -i out/hero-loop.mp4 -c:v libvpx-vp9 -crf 30 ../public/hero-loop.webm && ffmpeg -y -i out/showcase.mp4 -vcodec libx265 -crf 26 -tag:v hvc1 ../public/showcase.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -i out/showcase.mp4 -c:v libvpx-vp9 -crf 28 ../public/showcase.webm
scripts.encode:ad: ffmpeg -y -i out/ad.mp4 -vcodec libx265 -crf 26 -tag:v hvc1 ../public/ad.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -i out/ad.mp4 -c:v libvpx-vp9 -crf 28 ../public/ad.webm
